_comment: GPS-FREE EKF: ekf_default.json with the attitude aid from the MTi (no GPSNavEul) and heading NOT aided by it (its heading drifts tens of degrees). Heading and position come from land matching / VO. Use with run_stream.py --no_gt, and --imu model with a model trained on configs/exp/UAV/gpsfree_rotate_smooth.conf.

attitude_aid._comment: MTi AHRS attitude, tilt only. std_tilt_deg 1.5 = its measured roll/pitch RMS vs the nav solution on this corpus (1.4 / 1.8 deg). std_yaw_deg null: heading is not used.

vo._comment: frame of the VO file: frd (VO contract) or flu.  var_scale inflates the VO variance (VO error is time-correlated).  lever_arm_m: IMU -> camera, body FLU.
vo._cadence: VO gives one new image pair per 500 ms (frame_gap 10) but writes a row every telemetry tick. fresh_only keeps one row per pair: visual_age == 0 / visual_present == 1 if the CSV has it, else one row per min_interval_s.

vo_sim._comment: Only for --vo_sim.  null stds = split the measured VO RMSE [3.5, 2.7, 0.95] m/s between white noise and a slow Gauss-Markov error.

position_aid._comment: Absolute position fixes (land matching), world NWU m.  Key names are unique (pos_*) because the C++ reader looks keys up by name.  pos_use_vertical false = north/west only (matchers rarely give a usable height).  pos_lever_arm_m: IMU -> the point the fix refers to (camera), body FLU.  pos_replay_s: history kept so a LATE fix is applied at its own image time (rewind + re-run); fixes older than that are dropped.  Lock-out: after pos_reset_after rejected fixes in a row that agree within pos_reset_agree_sigma, the position is reset to the fix.  pos_std_m / pos_var_scale: for a CSV without its own uncertainty, and an inflation of whatever it has (matching errors are correlated).

pos_sim._comment: Only for --pos_sim: SIMULATED fixes from GPS truth.  std_m white + bias_std_m slow (Gauss-Markov, tau_s) error per axis, latency_s late, outlier_rate wrong matches off by outlier_m.

stream._comment: Stream (real-time) mode only.  A measurement older than max_meas_age_s is dropped; an IMU gap longer than max_imu_gap_s is not integrated (the state coasts and its covariance grows by gap_acc_std).
